text:
Connor (sales): looping everyone in — Hyperspace wants a short POC. they asked for a Dedicated GPU pool and VPC access. can we size this and outline the asks?
Maya (solutions): thanks. quick Qs: which model family + max context? and target peak qps / concurrent requests?
raj_hyperspace (guest): thanks — primary model is a Llama3-70B variant, 8k ctx for now. target is ~12 rps sustained with burst to 40 rps, concurrency ~10. latency target <200ms p50 if possible.
Ethan (infra): ok h100 preferred for 70B. rough back-of-envelope: 12 sustained rps @ 8k ctx will need ~6-8 H100s depending on batching. burst headroom to 40 might need autoscale to ~12-14 H100s.
Maya (solutions): do we want regional failover? customer asks EU-WEST1 primary but would like failover to US-WEST2.
Ethan (infra): cross-region failover is doable but doubles committed capacity if they want warm standby. cheaper option: async fallback to hosted smaller model in another region.
Priya (acct-exec): pricing note — committed reserved pool pricing vs on-demand. for 3-month POC we can do a temporary discounted commit; need exact # of GPUs to quote.
Noah (security): VPC peering + customer-managed NAT OK. we need the CIDR allowlist, and they'll need KMS for key encryption? also, are they requesting private control plane or just VPC peering to hosted?
raj_hyperspace (guest): prefer VPC peering to hosted control plane, with API keys restricted to outbound egress IPs. KMS in their cloud for data-at-rest is required.
Maya (solutions): action items: (1) ethan — provide H100 count estimate for steady + burst and an autoscale config suggestion, (2) priya — draft 3-month pricing with reserved vs on-demand columns, (3) noah — list security checklist for VPC peering + KMS/HSM notes, (4) connor — I'll draft the POC runbook for Hyperspace.
Ethan (infra): noted. quick config suggestion: start with 8 H100s in eu-west1 with autoscale policy to add 2 nodes per 10% CPU/queue increase, max 14. enable KV cache with 2-token warmup to reduce token cost.
Priya (acct-exec): i'll put together numbers. estimate for 8 H100 reserved (3mo) vs on-demand — will share in slack by EOD.
Noah (security): for peering we need: customer VPC CIDR, peering contact, allowed IP ranges for API egress, KMS key ARN + IAM role. add requirement: audit log access for token usage.
Connor (sales): good. Raj — can you confirm CIDR and whether you have a KMS key ready? also confirm whether you want warm standby in US or async fallback.
raj_hyperspace (guest): CIDR: 10.24.0.0/16. we can provisioning a KMS key — will share ARN by EOD. prefer async fallback for cost reasons, but want failover test during POC.
deploy-bot: [system] reserved-pool-request created #PR-8342 referencing Hyperspace POC.
Maya (solutions): I'll compile this into a POC checklist and share a short runbook. Ethan — please include expected tail latency numbers for 8 vs 14 H100s.
Ethan (infra): will do. rough tail latencies: 8 H100s p95 ~220-280ms depending on batching; 14 H100s p95 ~150-180ms. will validate with a microbenchmark.
Priya (acct-exec): pricing posted to thread: provisional quote attached in DM.
Connor (sales): thanks all. i'll coordinate a kickoff with Hyperspace once we have the quote + KMS + CIDR. :thumbsup:
raj_hyperspace (guest): perfect — thanks team, looking forward to the kickoff.
_comment: Slack thread: Dedicated GPU pool sizing, region failover, VPC/KMS asks for a Hyperspace POC. Field names are top-level strings/lists per agents.md schema.
